coder_notes: Not a cancer trial: diabetic kidney disease. The only 'GBM' in the record is 'Glomerular basement membrane (GBM) width' as a kidney histology outcome, which is not the anti-GBM disease category either (no anti-GBM disease is studied), so coded not_glioblastoma. Canagliflozin is the sole study drug (rule 4 role) but has no antitumour purpose, hence no eligible candidate.
